column1: # QUESTIONS AND REQUESTS ABOUT MATERIALS, AND THE CARD EACH ONE SHOULD REACH.
# A HELD-OUT SET, kept so that a change to retrieval - or to any material card -
# can be measured against sentences nobody tuned anything to. Written 2026-10-09
# for FRAGMENT-ISSUES row 5b-396, in two parts:
#   - the first 44 lines below were written BEFORE any fix was tried;
#   - the rest were written by skeptics hired to BREAK candidate fixes, each
#     reading a candidate and inventing sentences it might get wrong.
# They are a session's sentences, not the owner's: tests/data/owner-questions.yaml
# is his set, and it stays the one that decides.
# FORMAT: TAG <TAB> sentence. '#' lines are comments. No line is a phrase any
# card declares (checked against main 17040842), so every answer is ranked.
#   Q  a question about what an element is made of  -> READ_ELEMENT_MATERIAL
#   C  asking to make a material                    -> CREATE_MATERIAL
#   S  selecting by a material                      -> SELECT_BY_MATERIAL
#   L  listing a document's materials               -> LIST_MATERIALS, once it exists
#   X  anything else near these cards - judge each one by reading it
# Ask each sentence through heron_brain.lookup (mcp/server/heron_brain.py), the
# function heron_lookup calls, on a SCRATCH store (HERON_KNOWLEDGE set; never
# %APPDATA%, row 5b-233), on both backends where possible.
# MEASURED ON main 17040842, 480 fragments, no Revit filter: of the 69 Q lines,
# 29 reach a card that WRITES on the lexical backend and 20 on the trained one
# (model2vec potion-base-8M) - nearly all of them CREATE_MATERIAL or
# REPLACE_MATERIAL. Row 5b-396 says why, and what ten card-only fixes cost.
# NEVER DECLARE A SENTENCE FROM THIS FILE ON A CARD. It would win by its exact
# words and the file would stop measuring anything - the same rule
# brain/retrieval-history.md keeps for the owner's questions.
